<CLT=cltMIND>I should head to the dining hall.
We're all supposed to meet there.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure we're going to train today,
I should head to the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>I have a bad feeling about this...
but I need to go to the gym.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll...just go to the dining hall now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko wants a favor?
I should ask her about it...

Angie should be preparing the ritual in the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Artist<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s research lab!

We don't have time to loiter around!
Let's hurry up and stop Angie!

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to get inside that lab!
I'm worried about Angie!

<CLT=cltMIND>I should go to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Anthropologist<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab...
I need to investigate that katana.

<CLT=cltMIND>So the seance is to be performed
in the middle room...

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to head to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shrine of Judgment<CLT=cltMIND>
in the courtyard...
